symptom: `diff-local --ref HEAD` (MPR v2) reported `0 new, 3 modified` while dozens of untracked .mxunit files sat under mprcontents/ — a new module's pages and flows, never `git add`ed, were missing
cause: findChangedMxunitFiles asked only `git diff --name-status <ref>`, which lists tracked files; an untracked file is invisible to it
insight: Against the working tree the question is 'what is in the folder that is not at ref', and git splits the answer between diff (tracked) and ls-files --others (untracked). Ask both; a range compares two commits and must not look at the working tree. Stubbed-git tests must answer the new command, or they fail with exit 128. Real-git test: commit a unit, write a second one untracked, diff HEAD → want 1 new.
